skill.displayName: Free AI Ghost Mannequin Generator - Remove Mannequin from Clothing Photos Instantly – CLI-powered
skill.summary: AI ghost mannequin generator — create a professional ghost mannequin effect from a clothing photo

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of ai-ghost-mannequin-generator-cli-skill

- Introduces a CLI skill to generate AI-based ghost mannequin effects from clothing photos.
- Requires weshop-cli and a WESHOP_API_KEY environment variable for secure API access.
- Supports custom aspect ratios (auto, 1:1, 2:3, etc.) and image sizes up to 4K resolution.
- Provides guidance for secure API key handling and setup instructions.
- Outputs professional studio-style ghost mannequin images with batch processing support.
